product_metadata.title: CorningWare Meal Mug with Vented Lid for Steam, 20-Oz Stoneware Soup Mug, BPA-Free Lid, Microwave, Freezer, and Dishwasher Safe, Blueberry
features: VERSATILITY IN A CUP: Quality of life doesn't have to come in a big package. CorningWare's meal mug is a simple yet highly functional piece that adapts to your favorite meals, from soups and snacks to noodles and rice.

DURABLE MATERIAL: This CorningWare meal mug is made from high-quality ceramic that resists chips and cracks, helping provide a long-lasting household essential item. The plastic lid is non-toxic, BPA-Free.

LOW MAINTENANCE: This meal mug is designed to provide the best eating experience while requiring low maintenance. The high-gloss exterior is non-porous and easy to clean. It is also dishwasher, freezer, and microwave safe.
LIMITED WARRANTY: This item has a limited warranty. Do not use abrasive cleaners, scouring pads, or any object that will scratch stoneware items.
EFFORTLESS ELEGANCE: CorningWare elevates your everyday by offering superior craftsmanship.
description: The CorningWare 20-Ounce Meal Mug with Vented Lid is perfect for microwaving coffee, tea, soup, oatmeal, and much more. A removable, vented lid allows steam to escape, keeping the microwave clean and preventing burns. The mug is made of durable stoneware material that resists chipping and cracking and features a high-gloss exterior that is non-porous, easy to clean, and won't absorb flavors, odors, or stains. Both the mug and the BPA-free plastic lid are dishwasher, freezer and microwave safe..
